artemnovitckii-claude-animation-skills-b.description: Makes a 3D exploded-view animation for a reel. A phone floats on a dark studio backdrop, comes apart layer by layer (glass, screen, frame, board and battery, back), and each part gets a thin leader line and a label. Use when the user runs /breakdown or asks for an exploded view, a "what's inside" teardown or a labelled 3D breakdown of a device.

artemnovitckii-claude-animation-skills-d.description: Makes Dan Koe style minimal black-and-white line art for a reel. One white dot on pure black grows into a hairline tree that splits in two at every step, the tips light up, a pulse ring and sparks go off, and one quiet lowercase line swaps to a second. Use when the user runs /dan-koe or asks for Dan Koe style visuals, calm black and white motion graphics about choices, habits or compounding, or line art with one moving dot.

artemnovitckii-claude-animation-skills-g.description: Makes a minimal line-graph animation for a reel. A smooth black line draws itself on white (or white on black) while one big number counts up with the tip, then lands on the final value. Use when the user runs /graph or asks for a growth chart, a "0 to 100K" number animation or an animated stat.

artemnovitckii-claude-animation-skills-k.description: Makes a Kurzgesagt style flat-vector space explainer shot for a reel. Deep navy-purple space with twinkling stars, flat planets lit from one side with a dark crescent and a soft glow, bright rounded label tags and a white caption low in the frame. The built-in scene stacks all seven planets, to scale, between Earth and the Moon at its farthest. Use when the user runs /kurzgesagt or asks for a Kurzgesagt-style animation, a flat vector space or science explainer shot, or a planets-to-scale visual.

artemnovitckii-claude-animation-skills-l.description: Makes a PS1/N64-era low-poly 3D animation for a reel, in the style of "low poly shorts". Chunky low-resolution pixels, wobbly vertices, dithering, flat warm lighting and small yellow captions with a thin black outline. The built-in scene is a train platform: a dog sits and waits, a train brakes in and pulls away, and he is still there in the snow. Use when the user runs /low-poly or asks for a low-poly, PS1-style, retro 3D or "low poly shorts" animation.

artemnovitckii-claude-animation-skills-m.description: Makes a 3D map animation for a reel. A clean white city with parks and a river, a coloured route that draws itself from start to destination while the camera follows, a red pin that drops with a bounce, an ETA card that counts down and a destination card. Use when the user runs /map-route or asks for an animated route, a "from A to B" map, a journey or a commute animation.

Makes a Minecraft-style blocky voxel animation for a reel. A cottage builds itself block by block on a grassy hill, about 165 blocks dropping in with a bounce, then the chimney slams in with a puff of dust, the windows light up warm, smoke rises and a big pixel-font word lands. Procedural 16x16 pixel textures, blocky trees and flat blocky clouds, rendered with three.js. Use when the user runs /minecraft or asks for a Minecraft-style, voxel or blocky animation, or a build-it-block-by-block visual.

Makes a minimal black-and-white line-art animation for a reel. Thin outlined steps rise one by one, a white dot hops up them, and at the top an orbit draws around it and a short second line swaps in. One quiet lowercase line of text on top. Use when the user runs /minimalistic-graphics or asks for simple black and white motion graphics, a calm self-improvement visual or line art with one moving dot.

artemnovitckii-claude-animation-skills-s.description: Makes a code-animated stick-figure explainer reel (9:16, 30 to 45 s) from a question or topic. A bright cartoon world with thick outlines, stick people with big white heads and faces, constant camera motion, whip transitions, 1 to 2 word captions, a playful underscore and cartoon sound effects, all generated in code and timed to the voiceover word by word. Use when the user runs /stick-figure or asks for a stick-figure, stickman or cartoon "what if" explainer.

artemnovitckii-claude-animation-skills-z.description: Makes a 3D cartoon "what if" explainer short (9:16) entirely in code with three.js, in the style of Zack D. Films-type videos. The same skill as /zach-d-films under the name used in the reel. Procedural cartoon people, props and effects, slow-motion impacts, a red force ripple and 1 to 3 word captions timed to the voiceover. Use when the user runs /zach-3d-films or asks for a 3D cartoon explainer or a "could X stop Y" short.

Makes a 3D cartoon "what if" explainer short (9:16) in the style of Zack D. Films-type videos, entirely in code with three.js. Procedural cartoon people, props and effects, a blue studio sky, slow-motion impacts, a red force-ripple overlay, quick whip cuts and 1 to 3 word captions timed to the voiceover. Use when the user runs /zach-d-films or asks for a 3D cartoon explainer, a "could X stop Y" or "what if" short with characters and props.
